_meta.note: Incentives snapshot for the Policy engine. Static JSON; update manually on change (TNB + MAV review), scraper polls announcements.

ev_duty_exemption.note: CBU (imported) EV import + excise duty exemption ended 31 Dec 2025. CKD (locally assembled) EVs keep the excise duty and sales tax exemption.

ev_road_tax.note: From 1 Jan 2026 EVs pay the JPJ power-based (kW) schedule; the RM2 flat rate ended 2025. Per-car figures are in catalog ownership.road_tax_rm.

myev.note: GoM programmes: NEM 3.0 rooftop solar net metering, charging-point development incentives

ev_charging_grant.note: Individual income-tax relief up to RM2,500 for EV charging equipment.

hybrid.note: Hybrids: standard import duty + excise (CKD). No special EV incentives; road tax standard formula. Hybrid incentives were removed after 2022 for most models.

notes: Source: MITI/MoF announcements (CBU exemption end 2025, CKD to 2027), JPJ 2026 EV road tax, Budget 2027 (9 Oct 2026: no new private-buyer EV incentive). Manual review on change.
